description: List every folder in a course's Files area, including each folder's name, full path, parent_folder_id, and file/subfolder counts, but not the files or subfolders inside each one. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use list_files to see the files inside a folder, and upload_file's `parent_folder_path` to place a file in — and implicitly create — a folder path that doesn't exist yet; Canvas creates any missing segment along the way rather than requiring it to already exist.
name: list_folders
title: List Folders
